title: trial started
description: The note an app writes in its own folder on its first start with no license, so its trial, a rule in mankit and not a license, knows when it started and on which install (ADR-L9): a Resource (ADR-S15), plain and unsigned. mankit's license check writes and reads it for every app. Rules no schema can say, as they need today's date and the binary on disk: a note that cannot be read, is dated after today, or whose binary or fileTime differs from the running binary counts as none, so the app starts a fresh trial and writes a new note. Several app versions read it at once: apiVersion, kind and metadata never change; spec may grow (ADR-S15).

apiVersion.description: The form the note is in, so a reader knows which schema it meets (ADR-S15, apiversion/v1/forms.yaml).

kind.description: Always TrialStarted, the kind of this note.

metadata.description: Which app's trial this is. It never changes in trial/v1 (ADR-S15).

id.description: The product id of the app whose trial this is, so a note copied into another app's folder is not taken as that app's.

spec.description: When and on which install the trial started. Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older app accepts them (CT-RULE-4).
